Agent Name: WebSurfer
Step Number: 4
Reason for Mistake: The WebSurfer agent failed to extract the critical information regarding the distinction (that Muggsy Bogues is the shortest head coach in WNBA history) from the Wikipedia page shown in Step 3. Instead of synthesizing the available data which explicitly stated he was the "shortest player ever to play in the National Basketball Association" and later became a WNBA head coach, the agent incorrectly assumed this fact was not confirmed and initiated redundant, ineffective searches in Step 4. This failure to utilize existing search results to form a conclusion led to the agent getting stuck in a loop of searching for the same information without ever extracting the answer from the visible text.
